entry.title: New: RES26-193 (Honolulu) — INTRO
entry.content:
URGING THE UNITED STATES ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY AND THE HAWAIʻI STATE DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH TO REQUIRE THE UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF THE NAVY TO INCREASE THE FREQUENCY, CHEMICAL SCOPE, AND GEOGRAPHIC EXTENT OF GROUNDWATER TESTING FOR PER- AND POLYFLUOROALKYL SUBSTANCES AND PETROLEUM CHEMICALS IN THE IMMEDIATE VICINITY OF THE RED HILL BULK FUEL STORAGE FACILITY AND SURROUNDING AREAS.

Latest action: Introduced.
